{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blouse with a subtle sheen, relaxed straight cut, elbow length, obsidian black, silk-blend crepe.
High-waisted wide-leg trousers, tapered ankle opening, midi length, charcoal grey, heavy wool gabardine.
Structured blazer, single-breasted notched lapel, hip length, midnight blue, unlined tweed with matte finish.
Ankle boots with a block heel, pointed toe, classic silhouette, jet black, polished leather.
This outfit strikes the right balance for an evening at a rock concert while adhering to her request for stream and classic style. The dark monochromatic palette of charcoal and midnight blue ensures she stands out against stage lighting without appearing overly flashy or revealing. Heavy wool and structured tweed provide necessary warmth for autumn weather while maintaining a refined silhouette suitable for standing in a crowd."}
